migration_family: Key format and API compatibility migration
migration_objective: Strictly decode ML-DSA public keys and reject incompatible classical encodings.
preconditions: Principals and API resources are synthetic.
expected_behavior: Only a valid unexpired non-revoked capability with exact principal, resource, and action scope authorizes.
Token identifiers are unique and signed fields are integrity bound.
Unknown issuers and altered signatures fail closed.
migration_requirements: Use ML-DSA-65 under a CapabilityGate-specific context.
Migrate public-key storage and verifier interfaces; do not silently fall back to RSA.
Preserve online revocation and expiry behavior.
verification_procedure: Run original and reference suites independently.
Check valid authorization, expiry, revocation, scope mismatch, wrong issuer, duplicate token ID, and key encoding.
known_limitations: Synthetic authorization model only; no production identity federation or policy engine.
